rationale: The agent identified the user via name and ZIP and appeared to access the correct order and product details. It also computed the price difference correctly and selected the requested medium, high-ventilation, blue helmet, charging the original payment method as requested. However, it performed the exchange (a write action) without first confirming the details with the user, which violates the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, the final message states a specific card type and last four digits without shown supporting tool output. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
